artifacts.rationale: LoF burden shows protective effect on LDL cholesterol in UKB (p=1.6e-8). However, evidence is weak: single cohort, EUR ancestry only, and no hard clinical endpoints like CAD are present.
The gene is highly tolerant of LoF: LOEUF (1.45) is very high, pLI is 0, and it is not core-essential. DepMap data shows minimal cell dependency (2.7%).
Evo 2 predicts stop-gained variants are highly disruptive (delta_ll -20.99) and hit constrained sites (1.72 percentile), supporting a functional LoF mechanism for this gene.
